an4.233:1.1: cattārīmāni bhikkhave kammāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditāni
an4.233:1.5: atthi bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ sukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ
an4.233:1.6: atthi bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati.
an4.233:2.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco sabyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti sabyāpajjhaṃ vacīsaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti sabyāpajjhaṃ manosaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti
an4.233:2.3: so sabyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharitvā sabyāpajjhaṃ vacīsaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharitvā sabyāpajjhaṃ manosaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharitvā sabyāpajjhaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati
an4.233:2.4: tamenaṃ sabyāpajjhaṃ lokaṃ upapannaṃ samānaṃ sabyāpajjhā phassā phusanti
an4.233:2.5: so sabyāpajjhehi phassehi phuṭṭho samāno sabyāpajjhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyati ekantadukkhaṃ seyyathāpi sattā nerayikā
an4.233:2.6: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ.
an4.233:3.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco abyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti abyāpajjhaṃ vacīsaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti abyāpajjhaṃ manosaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti
an4.233:3.3: so abyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharitvā abyāpajjhaṃ vacīsaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharitvā abyāpajjhaṃ manosaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharitvā abyāpajjhaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati
an4.233:3.4: tamenaṃ abyāpajjhaṃ lokaṃ upapannaṃ samānaṃ abyāpajjhā phassā phusanti
an4.233:3.5: so abyāpajjhehi phassehi phuṭṭho samāno abyāpajjhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyati ekantasukhaṃ seyyathāpi devā subhakiṇhā
an4.233:3.6: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ.
an4.233:4.1: katamañca bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ sukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ
an4.233:4.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco sabyāpajjhaṃpi abyāpajjhaṃpi kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti sabyāpajjhaṃpi abyāpajjhaṃpi vacīsaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti sabyāpajjhaṃpi abyāpajjhaṃpi manosaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti
an4.233:4.3: so sabyāpajjhaṃpi abyāpajjhaṃpi kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharitvā sabyāpajjhaṃpi abyāpajjhaṃpi vacīsaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharitvā sabyāpajjhaṃpi abyāpajjhaṃpi manosaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharitvā sabyāpajjhaṃpi abyāpajjhaṃpi lokaṃ upapajjati
an4.233:4.4: tamenaṃ sabyāpajjhaṃpi abyāpajjhaṃpi lokaṃ upapannaṃ samānaṃ sabyāpajjhāpi abyāpajjhāpi phassā phusanti
an4.233:4.5: so sabyāpajjhehipi abyāpajjhehipi phassehi phuṭṭho samāno sabyāpajjhaṃpi abyāpajjhaṃpi vedanaṃ vediyati vokiṇṇasukhadukkhaṃ seyyathāpi manussā ekacce ca devā ekacce ca vinipātikā
an4.233:4.6: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ sukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ.
an4.233:5.1: katamañca bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati
an4.233:5.2: tatra bhikkhave yampīdaṃ kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ tassa pahānāya yā cetanā yampīdaṃ kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ tassa pahānāya yā cetanā yampīdaṃ kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ sukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ tassa pahānāya yā cetanā
an4.233:5.3: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati.
an4.233:5.4: imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri kammāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditānīti.
